description: Start payment for a stage. Needs credentials. Without sharedPaymentToken you receive the link to our payment page (form.redirect), which you may complete yourself with a card issued to you, or hand to the person you act for; on that page the card must be in the name on the invoice (for a company: its representative or the company name) and the cardholder address must be in the invoice country, and every order placed by an AI agent needs the cardholder to confirm with the bank (3-D Secure). With a delegated shared payment token the payment settles directly. The request must come from a verified robot: signed by its maker (Web Bot Auth) or from the published addresses of its maker. If the owner of the agent verified a DNS record with kya_challenge and kya_verify, the record is read again at payment and its limit applies; kya_status reads it. KYA does not grant buyer payment authority. On-chain payment is not accepted. Errors: OFFER_EXPIRED (409) for an advance after 30 days, FINAL_NOT_RELEASED (409) when the final payment is not open yet, OWNER_APPROVAL_REQUIRED (409) for a first order above EUR 1000 from a new e-mail or card until the merchant approves it, BUYER_BLOCKED (403), PAYMENTS_DISABLED (503).

clientId.description: Required unless you authenticate with the Authorization header (Bearer <clientId>:<secret>, or an OAuth access token issued for this server). The clientId returned by register_agent.

order.description: The order id returned by create_order.

secret.description: Required unless you authenticate with the Authorization header (Bearer <clientId>:<secret>, or an OAuth access token issued for this server). The secret returned by register_agent.

sharedPaymentToken.description: Only for delegated payment without a hosted page: a Stripe shared payment token granted to the seller profile in manifest.payment.networkBusinessProfile. Leave it out to receive the link to our payment page instead.

stage.description: advance: the first payment, open after accept_offer. It is 50% of the total, or the whole total when the service is paid at once (paymentPlan single in the catalogue). final: the remaining 50%, open only after the advance is paid and the seller has released the work for final payment. Defaults to advance.

name: start_payment
